title: Fail-closed connection admission order
summary: A remote connection is admitted in a fixed order: accept TCP, obtain numeric peer address, perform exact source-IP admission before reading protocol bytes, parse/authenticate HELLO, re-check the selected peer/IP binding, authenticate CHALLENGE, derive session keys, then accept encrypted commands.
invariants: An unlisted source is closed before HELLO is read and before cryptographic peer authentication.
Passing the aggregate IP gate is insufficient: the selected peer identity must also be bound to the actual source IP.
Passing either IP gate never bypasses cryptographic proof or receiver/queue authority.

provenance.claim: Canonical admission sequence and the rule that IP admission does not replace identity/ACL checks.
Listener source shows pre-HELLO aggregate IP rejection, then peer-specific IP binding, then HELLO HMAC verification.
